subject: Re: Invoice 202704-INV78 — alternative to legal hold for public-sector procurement
messages:
From: Maxine O'Donnell <maxine.odonnell@citygrid.gov.uk>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Officer <procurement@citygrid.gov.uk>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Invoice 202704-INV78 — authorization delay and legal hold request

Hi Markus,

Apologies for the blunt note — our internal governance has flagged Invoice 202704-INV78 (Redwood Inference) as unpaid while the PO and final terms undergo counsel review. Legal have asked us to place a hold on fulfillment and collections until ratification is complete.

This is a multi-entity public-sector procurement and the PO is currently queued for the June committee (we expect confirmation late next week). Our Finance team have asked whether Redwood can pause collection activity and halt dunning/legal escalation until then.

Attached is the drafted PO we have (PO_draft_4521.pdf). Can you confirm:
- whether Redwood is able to accept a delayed payment schedule tied to PO ratification, and
- if there are steps we can take to avoid formal legal escalation for now (it would jeopardize the committee outcome).

We appreciate the flexibility. Happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Maxine O'Donnell
Senior Procurement Officer
CityGrid Council

Attachment: PO_draft_4521.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Maxine O'Donnell <maxine.odonnell@citygrid.gov.uk>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 May 2027 13:44:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Invoice 202704-INV78 — authorization delay and legal hold request

Hi Maxine — thanks for the heads up and the PO draft.

Short answer: we can be pragmatic here. We understand public-sector procurement cycles and the committee constraints. Before we agree to pause formal escalation / legal hold, we need a documented mutual action plan that protects both parties and specifies clear milestones. Proposed steps from our side:

- Redwood pauses automated dunning for 14 days (canary pause) while CityGrid confirms committee date.
- CityGrid provides a confirmed PO (signed or DocuSigned) or a formal written payment commitment by 2027-05-25.
- If a partial retainer is possible, a 30% payment against the invoice will remove immediate pressure and allow us to continue service.
- CityGrid shares the VAT treatment decision (reverse-charge vs. standard VAT) or interim VAT evidence — without VAT clarity Finance can't finalize application of credits.

If you can confirm acceptance, we'll draft a short mutual action document (one page) and route for a quick e-signature. I will CC Finance and Legal internally so we get their input.

We want to avoid legal escalation too — so long as there is a documented path that reduces our credit risk.

Happy to call today if helpful.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, EMEA
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, Maxine O'Donnell <maxine.odonnell@citygrid.gov.uk>, finance@citygrid.gov.uk
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Invoice 202704-INV78 — authorization delay and legal hold request

Markus / team — quick finance/treasury guidance.

We can approve an exception to hold off legal collections on a documented basis, subject to the following controls:

1) Mutual Action Plan (MAP): Use our Mutual_Action_Template.docx. MAP must include milestones (signed PO, retainer amount, committee confirmation date), an internal Redwood credit hold expiration date (we recommend 2027-06-08), and a fallback clause allowing Collections to resume automatically if milestones are missed.

2) VAT evidence: CityGrid must confirm VAT treatment. If reverse-charge applies, provide the vendor registration and council VAT reference by 2027-05-25. If VAT is chargeable, provide proof of payment routing for the retainer. Without VAT evidence we cannot post apply credits correctly.

3) Retainer: Accept 30% retainer as proposed — that reduces exposure and is sufficient to defer escalation. Treasury will post an interim allocation once funds clear.

4) Credit ops: We'll run a canary dunning pause (14 days) and log a manual watch. If there is any indication of funds being diverted or if committee date slips beyond the MAP window, Collections must be authorized to resume immediately.

5) Legal: We won't place a legal 'hold' on the account provided MAP is signed and retainer received. If the MAP is not completed by the 25th, submit for legal escalation.

I attach the MAP template for Mark us to propose to CityGrid (Mutual_Action_Template.docx).

Kimberly Park
Director, Treasury & Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Mutual_Action_Template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Maxine O'Donnell <maxine.odonnell@citygrid.gov.uk>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, finance@citygrid.gov.uk
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Invoice 202704-INV78 — alternative to legal hold for public-sector procurement

Thanks everyone — quick summary and next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

1) CityGrid to confirm PO signature or provide formal payment commitment by 2027-05-25.
2) CityGrid to remit 30% retainer against Invoice 202704-INV78 (details in MAP).
3) CityGrid to share VAT evidence or confirmation of reverse-charge rule by 2027-05-25.
4) Redwood will pause automated dunning for 14 days (canary pause) and will not place a formal legal hold provided MAP is signed and retainer received.
4b) Collections watch to expire on 2027-06-08 if milestones met; otherwise Collections auto-resume.
5) Kimberly/tax to confirm allocation steps once retainer clears; Laura, please confirm accounting code and AR flag.
6) Aditya, please prepare a one-slide board-risk brief (impact, exposure, mitigation, timeline) — target to share 2027-05-20.

Maxine — if you can sign the attached one-page MAP and route the retainer via your finance team, we will hold escalation. If a call helps to accelerate approvals I can be available tomorrow morning.

I'll attach the board one-pager for reference once Aditya has drafted it.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, EMEA
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Board_brief_onepager.pdf (application/pdf)
